title: Launch Party
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office prepares for a party with various interactions, conflicts, and plans. Michael plans an elaborate party to impress and compete with New York, while Dwight notices his website appears to have become self-aware. Characters discuss upcoming social events, office supplies, and personal relationships. The episode features humorous conflicts over pizza, office dynamics, and personal insecurities, culminating in a party broadcast to multiple states and various character interactions.
